findings.source_quote: We are not stoics—we hurt and cry when loved ones leave us.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “watu wasiojali” with wording meaning people who suppress or do not show their emotions, such as “stoiki,” so the contrast with hurting and crying is preserved.
findings.translation_quote: Sisi si watu wasiojali—huumia na kulia wapendwa wanapotutoka.

findings.source_quote: We are not “drop-outs” because we don’t hold “respectable, secure” jobs—we’re “sold-outs.”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “waliotupa” with a term meaning people who have dropped out or opted out, preserving the contrast with being fully committed to Christ; for example, “Sisi si ‘waliojitoa’ kwa sababu hatuna kazi ‘zenye heshima na usalama’—sisi ‘tumejitoa kikamilifu.’”
findings.translation_quote: Sisi si “waliotupa” kwa sababu hatuna kazi “zenye heshima na usalama”—sisi “tumejitoa kikamilifu.”

findings.source_quote: A black-and-white globe centered on Africa
findings.suggested_fix: Specify that the image shows a globe, for example: “Tufe la dunia nyeusi na nyeupe, Afrika ikiwa katikati.”
findings.translation_quote: Dunia yenye rangi nyeusi na nyeupe, Afrika ikiwa katikati
